items.title: Outlook goes down mid-workday and X treats it as a day off
items.summary: A Microsoft 365 outage knocked out Outlook and Teams for hours across the Americas. Workers on X celebrated the break: "If Outlook doesn't come back within 30 minutes, can you legally go home?"
items.author: @iamtimmy
